meta.name: Philosopher Stone
meta.honest_note: No AGC algorithm, no transmutation logic, no decision code. Branding. Value is accountability machinery.

inspection_contract.desc: Every entity carries a self-describing identity card; one renderer audits all. Concrete 'no naked claims'.

authority_flags.desc: PROPOSAL_ONLY by default; mutation needs explicit flip + human gate. Maps to the two-key purge rule.

snapshot_schema: Object.freeze() + version string on world-state snapshots. Discipline for save()/load(): versioned, immutable, auditable.
safe_stop: On exception: 'SAFE_STOP · cause · use preserved baseline'. Name the fallback; never fail silently.
